structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" (5139282). With the page's default numbers (10,000 ₪ now, 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, 70,000 ₪ put in) I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪.

stuck.why: My own amount is 30,000 ₪, but I left the default 10,000, so 86,492 isn't really my number
7% a year for 10 years sounds like about 70% more to me, so 86k on 70k felt low. Then there's 'בכסף של היום' / 'אינפלציה', which I didn't really get

stuck.where: Fund list with lots of minus numbers (-447, -3,671 ₪...)
stuck.why: I didn't know if the minus means I lose money or just less than the top fund. I took the one that's picked and not in minus
